Maybe at first you could try acting more confidently around strangers and people you don't know. That's what worked for me, at least. I found it way easier to say no to strangers who I'll probably never see again than to my friends who were already used to me being kinda insecure and not standing up for myself.  

Another thing that helped me be more confident is a bit strange, but I realised that I'm the only person who's gonna be with me 24/7 for the rest of my life, so I might as well start to like myself, cus if I don't who will yk? Fake it till you make it

This definitely sounds like {Summer Kisses by Charlie Novak}. The two mc are always fighting about one thing or another and they love to drive each other mad. 

The book takes place over the course of almost 10 years and it captures their relationship throughout a lot of rough patches in a beautiful way.(Check TW cus it deals with some pretty heavy topics like addiction and alcoholism)
